scientific_question: Does a causal sequence of phase-local fixed-basis Cayley charts close the remaining attention-only loss and compute-equivalent gap caused by horizon-dependent direction drift?

evidence.dense_trajectory: At 5 TPP attention c_attn/c_proj need mean 90%-energy dimensions 3.0/4.4, but have path/chord 3.65/5.39 and median turns 79.6/82.0 degrees.
evidence.fixed_tangent: The deployed one-percent BlockFHT tangent remains at equal-rank random-subspace overlap throughout training.
evidence.capacity_radial: QK pair rank 64 and per-output radial gain improve the selected parent only modestly and do not remove the late-horizon gap at the first three fixed evaluations.
evidence.locality_control: A same-coordinate global FHT control was 0.0053 CE worse than repeated BlockFHT, so locality is not the isolated cause.

mechanism.function_continuity: Every future chart is identity initialized; activating it cannot change the current function.
mechanism.causality: At a registered boundary, the preceding chart is frozen and exactly one fresh chart receives gradients.
mechanism.parameterization: Each chart is a product of the same fixed-basis low-rank Cayley orbits; no learned dense basis, additive residual, or LoRA branch is used.
mechanism.resume_identity: The full start-step schedule is in the resolved config and exact checkpoint identity.

execution.selection_rule: Gate in listed order and train only the first exact configuration with measured MFU >= 0.20; validation loss cannot select stage count.

acceptance.instability: reject NaN, Inf, divergence, failed terminal evaluation, or MFU below 20%
